CHIEF COMPLAINT
Left ankle pain and swelling following a fall.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
36-year-old female presents with left ankle pain and swelling that occurred two days ago when she slipped on snow and ice while walking to her car. Patient reports her left ankle turned underneath her, more on the outside, and she fell. She was able to get up but experienced significant soreness, swelling, and pain, making it difficult to walk. Pain is localized to the outside of her ankle with no pain in the calf, lower leg, or knee. Patient has been treating at home with ibuprofen, ice, and elevation with minimal relief. Denies bleeding.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Denies pain above the ankle, in the calf, lower leg, or knee. Denies bleeding from the ankle injury.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Diabetes mellitus type 2
Hypertension
Systolic ejection murmur (unchanged from prior)

MEDICATIONS
Metformin
Norvasc

ALLERGIES
Not discussed.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not discussed.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Not discussed.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Neck: No bruits
Lungs: Clear
Heart: Normal, 2/6 systolic ejection murmur (unchanged from prior)
Abdomen: Good
Left ankle: Tenderness over lateral malleolus and fifth metatarsal, swelling, redness, pain with valgus stressing
Neurologic: Normal sensation
Vascular: Normal pulses

RESULTS
Not discussed.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
Ankle sprain with concern for possible fracture. X-ray of left ankle ordered to rule out fracture. Patient placed in air splint with crutches and instructed to avoid weightbearing pending x-ray results. Naprosyn 500 mg twice daily for pain control. Continue ice and elevation. Patient instructed to contact office if x-ray shows fracture; will refer to orthopedics if needed. If no fracture, patient to progress to partial weightbearing and remove air splint.

Diabetes: Continue metformin. Patient to keep scheduled ophthalmology appointment. Hemoglobin A1c and baseline labs ordered. Recent A1c was 6.8. Patient doing well with diet and exercise compliance.

Hypertension: Continue Norvasc. Refill issued. Blood pressure today 120/70.
